title: Promotions
empty: No promotions yet. Create one to lower prices for a period.
readOnly: Only a user allowed to change prices can edit a promotion.

hints.campaign: Seasonal sales, clearances and unpacking sales have a start and an end date. They keep the price charged before the campaign, for the declaration.
hints.trigger: Only a percentage promotion outside the seasonal sales can be a named discount.
hints.priority: When several promotions cover an item, the highest wins.
hints.minQty: The promotion applies from this quantity on the line.

outsideWindow: These dates are outside the seasonal sale periods set by the wali. Check them, or add the period in Settings › Sales and cash.

errors.amount: Enter an amount above zero, like 50 or 49.90.
errors.pieces: Enter a whole number of items, at least 1.
errors.bundle: A bundle holds at least 2 items.

declaration.title: Seasonal sale declaration
declaration.body: The products on sale, their price charged before the campaign and the quantities, for the declaration to the trade directorate.
